findings.summary: Partial output assembled override erased truncated representation and settled as stored.
findings.proof: Four-byte cap on eight-byte text previously produced stored/assembled, original_byte_length=8; regression now requires truncated/truncated and retains partial output reason.

findings.summary: CrewAI callback failure tracebacks exposed raw exception content.
findings.proof: Hostile property exception synthetic canary appeared in warning; both callback handlers now log fixed text without exc_info; regression checks two warnings and absent canary/traceback.

findings.summary: Terminal timeout/cancellation stopped applying after child closed IO pipes.
findings.proof: Child closed descriptors then slept 0.7 seconds; timeout 0.1 returned success/timed_out false. Regression now verifies owned child termination for timeout and cancellation.
